answer_1.quote: In this work we focus on jointly modeling both source code (PYTHON) and concomitant natural language documentation (docstrings) with transformers, through the study of dual tasks: generating method code bodies from signatures and docstrings, and generating docstrings from signatures and method code bodies.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates Python method bodies from signatures and docstrings, and generates docstrings from signatures and method bodies in various styles such as one-line, Google, Numpy, and reST.

answer_2.quote: The third row of tab. 3 shows PYMT5 has more than double the BLEU score, overall better recall, and significantly better ROUGE-2 and ROUGE-L F-scores than our GPT2 baselines.
